source: Curated cross-species comparative neuroscience; NOT extracted from MaleCNS v1.0 (see per-unit provenance.extracted_from_malecns).
caveat: A functional unit is a curated sub-circuit pattern, not a measured cell assembly. Members name neuron populations from synthetic_bio_topology.MODULE_PROFILES; ratios are composition weights, not measured cell counts. Treat as a compositional scaffold with literature provenance, not as ground truth. Where `embodiment.populations_anchored` > 0 the member populations DO correspond to real annotated MaleCNS v1.0 cell types, but the declared wiring and its connection FORM remain literature-derived -- see `provenance.extracted_from_malecns` (false everywhere).

port_types.*: Wildcard: any port type (used by generic forms).
port_types.sensory.skylight_compass: Polarised-light / sun-compass heading cue (insect central complex).
port_types.sensory.electric.ampullary: Low-frequency passive electric-field signal (prey bioelectric field).
port_types.sensory.electric.tuberous: High-frequency active-electrolocation signal (own EOD amplitude + phase).
port_types.sensory.lateral_line: Water-flow / pressure-wave signal from the lateral line.
port_types.sensory.auditory.startle: Abrupt acoustic transient able to trigger a startle response.
port_types.olfactory.sparse_code: Sparse high-dimensional odour code (mushroom-body Kenyon-cell output).
port_types.olfactory.learned_valence: Learned appetitive/aversive value attached to an odour.
port_types.navigation.heading: Angular head-direction (bearing) estimate.
port_types.navigation.steering: Turn command that reduces the heading-to-goal error.
port_types.motor.song: Vocal-motor command (syllable timing and syringeal drive).
port_types.motor.arm: Arm motion command issued from the arm nerve cord.
port_types.efference.copy: Efference copy / corollary discharge of a self-generated motor command.
port_types.sensory.infrared: Infrared (thermal-radiation) signal from a pit organ (trigeminal afferents).
port_types.sensory.vibrissa: Mechanosensory signal from a single whisker follicle.
port_types.thermal.vector: Bearing of a warm target derived from the infrared map.
port_types.spatial.place_code: Population code for the animal's current position.
port_types.rhythm.swim: Swim-rhythm phase (which half-cycle the oscillator is in).
port_types.gating.hunger: Hunger-state gate on a competing motor programme.
port_types.reafference.tactile: Self-generated tactile reafference from active sensing.

embodiment_source.scope: Presence + non-contradiction only. A matched population proves the parts exist in the real connectome; a nonzero measured pathway proves the declared edge is not contradicted at cell-type resolution. Neither proves the declared microcircuit or connection form. Declared edges measured at ZERO synapses are listed in `contradicted_edges` and are UNSUPPORTED, not supported.

acknowledged_contradictions.reason: The noduli population resolves to only 5 Nod cell types / 12 real cells, and the dataset files them under `visual_projection` rather than cb_intrinsic. MaleCNS v1.0 contains no Nod -> PFN/FS/FC synapses, so this declared projection is UNSUPPORTED at this resolution. Kept because it is a literature claim about the central complex, not a claim about this release's connectivity; a fix requires resolving the noduli population properly, which is future work.

how_to_compose: 2. join an out-port to an in-port whose `type` matches (or via a connection type whose from_port/to_port constraints admit both);
3. validate with compose_from_units(); it checks port type compatibility, required-port satisfaction and acyclicity policy.
